text: Because IIT holds that any system with Φ > 0 has some degree of consciousness, and virtually any interconnected physical system has Φ > 0, IIT implies a form of panpsychism.
explanation: True. IIT makes consciousness a graded, near-ubiquitous property, which is a form of panpsychism (in the lineage of Leibniz, Whitehead, and Strawson). This is a genuine implication Tononi accepts, though it inherits the combination problem — how micro-experiences would combine into macro-experience — which IIT tries to address via the exclusion postulate.
